definitions.gloss: more than enough; ample; exceeding full capacity
definitions.explanation: Going beyond what is sufficient or expected. Literally 'twelve parts out of ten' — exceeding 100 percent. Used to emphasize that something is more than adequate.

examples.japanese: {十二分|じゅうにぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめた→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoyed it more than enough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十二分|じゅうにぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The preparations are more than adequate.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十二分|じゅうにぶん}な⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This athlete has more than enough ability, so the chances of winning are high.

notes:
An intensified form of ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ (sufficient, enough). While ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ means "fully sufficient" (10 out of 10), {十二分|じゅうにぶん} goes beyond that — "120 percent."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十二分|じゅうにぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate to the fullest (and beyond)
- {十二分|じゅうにぶん}な⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧: more-than-sufficient results
- {十二分|じゅうにぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy thoroughly
- {十二分|じゅうにぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧: to make full use of

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the adverbial form {十二分|じゅうにぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. More emphatic than ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ but less colloquial than expressions like ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧すぎる.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧: sufficient, enough — the base form that this word intensifies
